labels.shortDescription: Error Log context for NPSP household adoption.
labels.value: NPSP household adoption

labels.shortDescription: Refusal when the user lacks Manage BarnCRM Settings.
labels.value: You need the Manage BarnCRM Settings permission to adopt NPSP households. Ask your BarnCRM admin.

labels.shortDescription: Refusal while household membership is Junction.
labels.value: Household membership is set to membership records, and NPSP households keep their people on each contact's account. Set Household membership to Contact on the General page, then adopt.

labels.shortDescription: Refusal when no NPSP household is left to adopt.
labels.value: There are no NPSP households left to adopt, or none you can see.

labels.shortDescription: Refusal when a run has nothing left to undo.
labels.value: This adoption has nothing left to undo.

labels.shortDescription: Refusal when the count changed. {0} now, {1} confirmed.
labels.value: {0} households match now, not the {1} you confirmed. Refresh the panel and confirm the new number.

labels.shortDescription: Refusal while another adoption or undo runs.
labels.value: An adoption or undo is already running. Wait for it to finish, then try again.

labels.shortDescription: Error Log Info entry after a run. {0} adopted, {1} skipped, {2} refused.
labels.value: NPSP household adoption finished: {0} adopted, {1} skipped because you cannot edit them, {2} refused (each refusal has its own Error Log entry).

labels.shortDescription: Error Log Info entry after an undo. {0} put back, {1} not put back.
labels.value: NPSP household adoption undo finished: {0} put back, {1} not put back (the reason is on each Household Adoption record).

labels.shortDescription: Undo note: the account was deleted.
labels.value: The account no longer exists.

labels.shortDescription: Undo note: the account is no longer a household.
labels.value: The account is no longer a household, so it was left as it is.

labels.shortDescription: Undo note: the user cannot edit the account.
labels.value: You cannot edit this account.

labels.shortDescription: Undo note: Salesforce refused the save. {0} is its reason.
labels.value: Salesforce refused the change: {0}

labels.shortDescription: Heading of the NPSP household adoption panel.
labels.value: Adopt NPSP Households

labels.shortDescription: Introduction under the panel heading.
labels.value: Turn NPSP's household accounts into BarnCRM households, in place: the same records, people and Opportunities. See what changes first, confirm the number, and undo it later if you need to.

labels.shortDescription: Shown when the org has no NPSP household marker.
labels.value: BarnCRM found no NPSP household accounts in this org.

labels.shortDescription: How many households can be adopted. {0} is the number.
labels.value: {0} NPSP households can be adopted.

labels.shortDescription: More households than one run takes. {0} is the run limit.
labels.value: More households than that are waiting. One run adopts up to {0}; run it again for the rest.

labels.shortDescription: Shown when nothing is left to adopt.
labels.value: Every NPSP household you can see is already a BarnCRM household.

labels.shortDescription: Caption of the sample table.
labels.value: The first households, as NPSP has them

labels.shortDescription: Sample table column: primary contact.
labels.value: Primary Contact

labels.shortDescription: Checkbox: keep NPSP names and greetings.
labels.value: Keep NPSP's names and greetings

labels.shortDescription: Help under the keep names checkbox.
labels.value: Marks each adopted household Custom Name, so its name and greetings stay as NPSP had them. Clear it to let BarnCRM name them from your naming settings. Names typed by hand in NPSP are kept either way.

labels.shortDescription: Button that starts an adoption.
labels.value: Adopt Households

labels.shortDescription: Adopt confirmation text. {0} is the number of households.
labels.value: {0} household accounts become BarnCRM households. No NPSP field changes, and you can undo it from this section.

labels.shortDescription: Label of the typed count before adopting. {0} is the number.
labels.value: Type {0} to adopt these households

labels.shortDescription: Confirm button in the adopt window.
labels.value: Adopt

labels.shortDescription: Shown while a run or undo is in progress.
labels.value: An adoption or undo is running. This section updates by itself.

labels.shortDescription: Heading for the newest run.
labels.value: Last adoption

labels.shortDescription: Newest run counts. {0} adopted, {1} undone, {2} not put back.
labels.value: {0} adopted, {1} undone, {2} not put back.

labels.shortDescription: Button and window title that undo the newest run.
labels.value: Undo This Adoption

labels.shortDescription: Undo confirmation text. {0} is the number of households.
labels.value: {0} households go back to the record type, greetings, primary contact and custom name they had before.

labels.shortDescription: Label of the typed count before undoing. {0} is the number.
labels.value: Type {0} to undo

labels.shortDescription: Shown after a run or undo starts.
labels.value: Started. This section updates as it runs.
